text: Shipped 0.1 after ~30 s of game time holding W (33 m). Onboarding text was clear: 'The boulder is your software... Hold E on one to patch it.' Release toast 'Shipped 0.1. New module: search.' is clear. No stamina bar appeared during 30 s of pushing although the help says pushing tires him.

Issue list column reads '-60%/min left', then '-60%/min far side' after the boulder rolled. 'left' reads as 'time left' next to a rate; it is actually where the module sits on the boulder. A new player cannot tell it is a direction. Expected e.g. 'on your left' or an arrow.

Patching auth worked first try: walked to the boulder until the prompt 'auth: expiring certificate ... Hold E to patch' showed, held E ~3 s; progress bar 'Patching (hold E) [####...]' filled and auth went to healthy 100%, health 92->96%. Clear and satisfying. The HUD location hint changed to 'facing you' when I was in reach - helpful once understood.

Shipped 0.3 (~85 s game time total). Contributor 'Gus is helping: on the way up, 2:30 left' appeared. Issue row 'billing drift 94% -35%/min under: roll' runs into the right edge of the 640 px window - the hint looks cut off ('under: roll' ... back?).

After 15 s more of game time pushing, 'Gus is helping: on the way up, 2:30 left' still reads 2:30 - the countdown does not move while he is 'on the way up', so the '2:30 left' looks wrong/frozen. Also no sign of Gus on screen.

Tried to roll the boulder back to reach 'billing ... under: roll' (I guessed the cut-off hint meant 'roll it back'). Walking round to the uphill side I lost the boulder completely: first person shows no marker and the 'The boulder: N m ...' line disappears when close, so I spun around for ~6 looks. V (behind view) finally showed it. Turning was also confusing: the HUD's '(to your right)' uphill hint did not update between some turns. Expected a persistent boulder direction hint, or the roll-back hint to say which way to walk.

Gus (blue shirt) is visible walking up the path from town while the HUD still says 'on the way up, 2:30 left' - so the countdown is not frozen, it just has not started; fine, but '2:30 left' reads as if he is already helping.

~5 minutes of wall time (about 40 s game time) spent failing to get back to the boulder on the 0.5 terrace. Pattern: turn with pt look until the boulder is on screen (back12: boulder right of centre, HUD still says 'The boulder: 6 m to your right' and 'behind you, down the hill'), hold W 3 s, and the boulder is gone from view again (back13). In the V view the camera swings late after a turn, and the HUD direction lines lag/contradict the picture, so I kept overshooting. billing rotted 47% -> 23% meanwhile. Expected: an easier way to approach the boulder (e.g. a 'walk to boulder' auto-face, a compass arrow, or a crosshair-centred HUD hint that is current).
Tab history works and is readable: 'now 0.x 3 min, 11 modules, 310 users, patched 2, helpers 1'. The version column says '0.x' for the current climb although the HUD says 0.5; I expected 0.5.
